mapper.select: SELECT LMS_PRF_ID FROM LMS_PROFILE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

SELECT l.LEC_ID AS lecId, lc.LEC_COD_NAME AS courseName, l.LEC_SECTION AS lecSection, s.SEM_YEAR AS semYear, s.SEM_TERM AS semTerm, l.LEC_VAL_STATUS AS lecValStatus FROM LECTURE l JOIN LECTURE_CODE lc ON lc.LEC_CODE_ID = l.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN SEMESTERS s ON s.SEM_ID = l.SEM_ID WHERE l.LMS_PRF_ID = #{professorLmsPrfId} ORDER BY s.SEM_ID DESC, lc.LEC_COD_NAME, l.LEC_ID
mapper.sql: SELECT asn.LEC_ASN_ID AS assignmentId, asn.LEC_ID AS lecId, lc.LEC_COD_NAME AS courseName, l.LEC_SECTION AS lecSection, s.SEM_YEAR AS semYear, s.SEM_TERM AS semTerm, asn.LEC_ASN_TITLE AS lecAsnTitle, asn.LEC_ASN_CONTENT AS lecAsnContent, TO_CHAR(asn.LEC_ASN_DUE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI') AS lecAsnDueDate, asn.LEC_ASN_VAL_STATUS AS lecAsnValStatus, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION sb WHERE sb.LEC_ASN_ID = asn.LEC_ASN_ID AND sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_STATUS != 'NSB') AS submittedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION sb JOIN ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION_EVALUATION ev ON ev.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID = sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID WHERE sb.LEC_ASN_ID = asn.LEC_ASN_ID AND ev.ASN_SBM_EVL_SCORE IS NOT NULL) AS gradedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e WHERE e.LEC_ID = asn.LEC_ID AND e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP') AS totalStudents FROM LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT asn JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = asn.LEC_ID JOIN LECTURE_CODE lc ON lc.LEC_CODE_ID = l.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN SEMESTERS s ON s.SEM_ID = l.SEM_ID
mapper.select: SELECT a.LEC_ASN_ID AS assignmentId, a.LEC_ASN_ATT_ID AS attachmentId, a.LEC_ASN_ATT_ORG_FIL_NAME AS fileName, a.LEC_ASN_ATT_EXT_TYPE AS fileExt, a.LEC_ASN_ATT_FIL_SIZE AS fileSize FROM LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT_ATTACHMENT a WHERE a.LEC_ASN_ID IN #{id} AND a.ATT_VAL_STATUS = 'ACT' ORDER BY a.LEC_ASN_ID, a.LEC_ASN_ATT_REG_DATE, a.LEC_ASN_ATT_ID

SELECT a.LEC_ASN_ID AS assignmentId, a.LEC_ASN_ATT_ID AS attachmentId, a.LEC_ASN_ATT_ORG_FIL_NAME AS fileName, a.LEC_ASN_ATT_EXT_TYPE AS fileExt, a.LEC_ASN_ATT_FIL_SIZE AS fileSize FROM LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT_ATTACHMENT a WHERE a.LEC_ASN_ID = #{assignmentId} AND a.ATT_VAL_STATUS = 'ACT' ORDER BY a.LEC_ASN_ATT_REG_DATE, a.LEC_ASN_ATT_ID

INSERT INTO LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT_ATTACHMENT ( LEC_ASN_ATT_ID, LEC_ASN_ID, LEC_ASN_ATT_REG_DATE, LEC_ASN_ATT_ORG_FIL_NAME, LEC_ASN_ATT_TRN_FIL_NAME, LEC_ASN_ATT_ORG_URL, LEC_ASN_ATT_FIL_SIZE, LEC_ASN_ATT_EXT_TYPE, ATT_VAL_STATUS ) VALUES ( SEQ_LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT_ATTACHMENT.NEXTVAL, #{assignmentId}, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{orgFileName}, #{trnFileName}, #{orgUrl}, #{fileSize}, #{extType}, 'ACT' )
